def min_swaps_to_sort(N, M, permutation, allowed_swaps):
    # Convert the permutation to a zero-indexed list for easier manipulation
    permutation = [x - 1 for x in permutation]

    swap_set = set((min(a, b) - 1, max(a, b) - 1) for a, b in allowed_swaps)

    queue = deque([(permutation, 0)])  # (current permutation, number of swaps)

                    if tuple(new_perm) not in visited:
                        visited.add(tuple(new_perm))
                        queue.append((new_perm, swaps + 1))
    
    # If we exhaust the queue without finding the target, something went wrong
